description.value:
Your lungs or palms are implanted with an organ that produces reflective, sticky dandruff, popularly known as a glittergland. The muscles surrounding the gland can contract in a spasm, expelling the glitter forward.

Activate—Glitterburst 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect A @Template[type:cone|distance:15] becomes coated in glitter. Invisible creatures in the area become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] instead. Creatures in the area that were already concealed for any other reason are no longer concealed. Affected creatures must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20] saving throw. Affected creatures are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled] for the duration.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The glitter affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The glitter affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The glitter affects the creature for 10 minutes.
